hypothesis: At near-matched parameter count, recurrent depth changes learning quality and training cost relative to width under the same fixed six-epoch labels-only recipe.
falsifier: No material or robust paired improvement of depth, or a throughput cost making its gain uneconomic, narrows this fixed-recipe depth proposal. It does not refute depth at matched compute or other schedules.
pay_to_win: More independent full fits reduce fitting-noise uncertainty; stronger labels-only parent may later serve fold-clean teacher/student experiments. No extra GPU throughput is assumed before profiling.
threshold_rationale: Pre-outcome engineering decision threshold for committing another accelerator-day to depth-specific follow-up. It is a project spending decision, not a universal effect threshold or a power calculation.
success: D at least +0.001 with positive conditional crossed-seed interval and no material fold fragility makes deep a follow-up candidate; analogous negative evidence favors wide. Downstream CPU/student transfer remains a separate experiment.
uncertain: Wide or zero-crossing intervals, fold reversals, or small effects require a targeted follow-up decision; a zero-crossing interval alone does not close the mechanism.
negative: A robust effect at or below -0.001 disfavors deep for this exact fixed-budget recipe.
primary_estimand: D=(1/4)*sum_f(mean_s(WPdeep_fs-WPwide_fs)); per-fit official scores, no seed prediction average.

fitting_interval.method: 10000 paired draws of the eight shared seed identities with replacement, same multiplicities across all folds; normalize by present seed multiplicity per fold; redraw if any fold has zero available multiplicity
fitting_interval.conditional_on: four exposed folds, fixed data/source/recipe/ancestry; only eight seed identities

evaluation_interval: Separate fixed-prediction source-qualified component-cluster paired resampling; unchanged per-pair grader emits component evidence. Do not confuse with fitting variability or private/public transfer.
multiplicity: One preregistered primary contrast in this family. Any future joint significance claim across backlog families requires a declared family and multiplicity treatment; historical adaptive exposure prevents pristine confirmation.
leakage_controls: canonical component-disjoint splits including source aliases
feature-only export and unchanged official masked weighted Pearson clip2 grader
representativeness_limit: Anonymous/source-qualified component folds do not certify chronology or a new market regime. Existing folds are exposed. No public-score claim from these results.
